summary.added_external_crate_count_note: P2-X3 admits no external crate. academic-dashboard links academic-curriculum, academic-domain, academic-record, academic-review and thiserror as product edges, and academic-audit, academic-curriculum, academic-domain, academic-ingestion, academic-offering, academic-proposal, academic-record, academic-review and trybuild as dev edges. Every one is covered by an earlier reviewed receipt. It adds one workspace path package. It links no store, vault, crypto, keystore, projection, policy, worker or transport crate at any feature setting: it persists nothing and claims no migration number.
summary.added_workspace_path_package_note: academic-dashboard is the P2-X3 Academic branch of the section 25.1 tree: sections 25.4, 25.5 and 25.6 plus the graduation-audit view. It holds three averages that cannot exist without the attempts behind them, the four section 25.4 display states over section 3.9's five engine statuses, the six-facet attempt timeline, a three-pane planner that re-reads six axes from the whole board on every drag, an immutable plan snapshot whose only response to a changed official reading is a marking, the four non-overlapping section 25.6 coverage tabs, and a percentage whose one producer takes its breakdown by value. It is a separate package from academic-home and academic-evidence-center for the same reason those two are separate from each other: three different routes, three different screens, and no crate depends on another.
summary.npm_workspace_package_note: P2-X3 adds no pnpm workspace package. Its shell half is two files inside the existing @academic-os/ui package, packages/ui/src/academic.ts and packages/ui/src/academic.test.ts, plus five entries in that package's existing view registry.

direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-curriculum: P2-U1's Course, CourseRevision, CourseOffering, CourseCode, TermCode, InstructorName, SectionCode, Credits and CurriculumCategory. Section 25.6's Official identity block is six fields and every one of them is read off P2-U1's own published revision rather than restated: CatalogIdentity::of takes both the course and the revision and refuses a revision of a different course. The planner's left rail is section 25.5's 공식 개설 CourseOffering, and a candidate carries the course code and term those types spell.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-domain: Section 3.9's ProofStatus, which is the five-valued proof-tree status section 25.4's four display words are a total image of; section 7.2's PredicateName, whose DESIGNED_TO_TEACH, TAUGHT_IN, PRACTICED_IN and ASSESSED_IN arms are what makes the four coverage tabs a partition rather than four labels; and CourseId, CourseRevisionId, OfferingId, AttemptId, EntityId, ContentDigest and ValidInterval for every identity a surface names.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-record: P2-U4's section 10 vocabulary. GpaValue, AttemptDisposition, DispositionReason and RepeatProof are the proof section 25.4's first line asks each average to carry; AttemptStatus, RepeatStatus, GradeSymbol, RecognitionDecision and TermKey are what the six timeline facets read; PlanScenarioChoice is section 10's 예정, which is deliberately not a CourseAttempt. The edge also puts RegistrationConfirmation inside this crate's closure on purpose: section 25.5's last sentence is an absence, and an absence over a type a crate cannot name is not an absence. planner_has_no_registration_endpoint measures it over this crate's whole product text and every_item_that_reaches_a_closed_type_is_pinned measures it over the whole workspace.
direct_workspace_dependencies.academic-review: P2-U8's ReviewScope, OfferingAggregate and BiasDisclosure. Section 25.6's last sentence is that a catalogue fact and an offering review must not look like the same property, and this edge plus the academic-curriculum edge are what make that a measurement rather than a tautology: both vocabularies are in this closure and the section a value may appear in is what separates them. A review section carries a distribution per dimension and nothing here reduces one, which is the line P2-U8 drew with scalar_is_not_a_course_property.

dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-audit: A dev edge on purpose. P2-U3 holds five of this surface's six blocking section 38 cells, and the claim is that two enumerations agree after each was read out of the design document. A product edge would make one crate's answer the other's by construction, which is the reason P2-L6 gives for its own academic-home dev edge. The cell academic-audit does not hold is the point of the comparison: GATE-38-005, the official transcript, which blocks every average on this screen and does not block a graduation engine that is handed an attempt set.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-curriculum: Declared a second time so the compile-fail cases, which compile against this crate plus its dev-dependencies, can name a CourseCode and a TermCode. academic-evidence-center, academic-scenario and academic-home declare their own edges twice for the same reason.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-domain: Declared a second time for the same trybuild reason: a case has to name a ProofStatus.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-ingestion: The review fixtures build a real P2-U8 record rather than an empty aggregate, and a record is collected from a P2-U6 permitted collection over a ConnectorId with a RetrievalInstant. An aggregate over no review would make catalog_and_review_are_separate_sections vacuous.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-offering: A dev edge for the same reason as academic-audit: GATE-38-017 is P2-U5's and stays open, and the two crates' readings of section 38.2's seventh bullet are compared rather than shared.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-proposal: The same review fixture needs P2-M2's low-risk autosave door, which is what makes an extraction's status AI_INFERRED by type.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-record: Declared a second time for the trybuild reason and because the acceptance suite drives P2-U4's own engine over P2-U4's own synthetic corpus: every average this surface publishes is compared against what that crate returned, so the oracle is not the code under test.
dev_workspace_dependencies.academic-review: Declared a second time for the trybuild reason.

why_this_dependency_belongs_inside_its_t: academic-dashboard is a workspace path crate, not an external dependency. It owns the four Academic routes of the section 25.1 tree and holds no writer: it has no edge of any kind to academic-store, academic-store-platform, academic-vault, academic-crypto, academic-keystore-platform, academic-core, academic-rpc, academic-projections, academic-recovery, academic-retention, academic-model-run, academic-worker, academic-policy or academic-egress-boundary, so the canonical writer, every key, every model run and every staged payload are outside the closure these surfaces compile against, and this task adds no migration. Its declared workspace closure of every product edge kind is exactly academic-curriculum, academic-domain, academic-record and academic-review, compared whole by workspace_dependency_direction_is_acyclic. Three absences carry their own claims. The first is the composite: academic-knowledge-state and academic-freshness are not in the closure, so section 10's 'GPA chart와 Knowledge Map을 같은 카드의 한 score로 합치지 않는다' is held the way P2-X2 holds its own -- the surface has no name for the other operand -- and the_dashboard_surface_cannot_name_a_mastery measures it over every product file with a control that requires the same reader to find MasteryLevel and FreshnessBand in academic-domain's own lib.rs, which is a product edge. The second is the verdict: there is no academic-audit and no academic-requirement product edge, so no rule, no requirement set and no proof tree is nameable from a product file here; this surface displays a status a caller supplies and computes none. The third is the registration: academic-record is in the closure and RegistrationConfirmation is therefore nameable, and no product file names it -- which is what makes section 25.5's 사용자의 실제 수강신청을 자동 수행하지 않는다 a measurement. Its resolved link closure intersected with the socket-capable crates is exactly [libc], which reaches it through academic-domain and through academic-policy's bundled SQLite by way of academic-curriculum.
network_posture: The crate opens no socket, declares no foreign function, reads no environment variable, spawns no process, and runs no build script. It invokes exactly one macro, format!, and the whole set of macros it invokes is compared in both directions by the_dashboard_crate_touches_no_file_and_no_socket. It reads no clock: every instant it holds arrived as an argument, which is why its acceptance suite can name the instants it asserts against. It reaches no model: academic-model-run is absent from its closure and no product file names ModelRun. The whole set of two-segment paths it spells through a crate root is [core::fmt, thiserror::Error], compared in both directions by the same test, and that test drives '<str as ::std::net::ToSocketAddrs>::to_socket_addrs(host)' through this crate's own copy of the reach reader, so the copy is measured rather than assumed to work. GATE-38-001 through GATE-38-006 are open and block the lines of section 25.4 that name them, so with no admission year, graduation standard, degree mode, additional major, official transcript or transferred-credit recognition the screen shows the exact missing check rather than a number; GATE-38-017 stays open every term, so every planner candidate is an official reading a caller supplies and nothing is carried over from a term that has passed. Every fixture is synthetic: the attempt ledger is academic-record's own synthetic corpus, and the curriculum, offering and review values are composed from P2-U1's and P2-U8's own drafts. No course code in it names a real catalogue entry.
advisory_path: Unchanged. Every external crate academic-dashboard links was admitted by an earlier receipt and is triaged through that receipt's advisory path. .github/dependabot.yml opens no version-update pull request.
